templateStanding: Machine-readable requirement matrix for the NEXT new independent-origin blind consumer. Organization of the original consumer-b.v10 charter only. Not a blind review, not design ACCEPT, not application, not an added semantic gate. Kit path and hashes are placeholders until a newly frozen successor is accepted. Do not populate from mutable source.

placeholders.CONSUMER_ID: new independent origin id, not a resume of consumer-b.v10
placeholders.KIT_PATH: absolute path of the frozen successor normative-only kit
placeholders.OUTPUT_PATH: absolute path of this origin's output directory
placeholders.KIT_MANIFEST_SHA256: SHA-256 of the successor consumer-input-manifest.json bytes

kinds.completeRun: Original required a complete positive Run descriptor graph (and its replay after admission).
kinds.completeRunProperty: Original attached this as Include/with/also on those complete Run graphs; exhibit it on the named Run(s), not as a substitute for them.
kinds.standaloneCanonicalVector: Original required independently authored/reconstructed vectors, tables, helpers, or controls without naming a complete Run.
kinds.standaloneConfigVector: Original said exercise a configuration shape; not each a separate complete Run.
kinds.standaloneTraceVector: Original required protocol traces, with executed reconstruction vs future-host assumptions stated.
kinds.schemaEnvelope: Original required public/failure/termination/purge envelopes validated from schemas.
kinds.evaluatorReplay: Original required semantic proof replay after identity/schema/closure admission for every claimed complete positive.
kinds.standingRule: Original standing/discipline that governs every claimed result.
kinds.futureQualification: Original excluded real OS/compiler/crypto/SQLite/host authentication as future qualification.
kinds.pendingSuccessorOwner: Not an original reconstruction demand. Reserved until the focused-query successor owner is handed off. Do not invent fields.

classificationRule: Classify by the original charter's own verbs (complete Run / include on those graphs / construct / exercise / reconstruct / derive / work through / future qualification). Do not upgrade vectors into Runs. Do not drop Include properties of Runs. Unexecuted items of any accept-blocking kind preclude ACCEPT even when they are not Runs.

acceptAllowedOnlyIf: Every acceptBlocking requirement is executed and retained as its observable artifact
Every claimed complete positive exported raw object table plus all blob/frame bytes

Every claimed complete positive independently validated against owning schemas including published kit keywords/registries, then independent retained closure and cross-record joins, then semantic proof replay
Helper failures were corrected from the normative kit only, with original failure and correction preserved; no open helper failure remains on a claimed positive
newMustIssues and newShouldIssues are empty only if no unresolved required finding remains
Unexecuted reconstruction is reported as incomplete, never as ACCEPT
acceptForbiddenIf: Any acceptBlocking item is unexecuted, delegated to a limitations list, or replaced by a schema-valid fragment that is not the required kind
Any claimed complete positive lacks exported frames/object table or fails independent closure/replay
Helper self-consistency (reminted C-byte equality, verdict/count equality, subset schema checks, inserted true) is offered as admission
A helper bug remains uncorrected, or was 'fixed' by importing author implementation or a prior review oracle
Future-qualification items are demanded as current blockers, or synthetic TCB observations are treated as native enforcement proof
stopCondition.afterExport: Every asserted complete positive must be independently root-admitted from the exact exported frames afterward. That is process observability of the original closure discipline, not a new semantic recipe and not a licence for the consumer to import author models.
stopCondition.continuation: Same-origin continuation is allowed if interrupted. Load all prior checkpoints. Do not reset scope. Do not replace substantive reconstruction with an accepting summary.

checkpointSchema.mergeRule: A later phase or continuation must union requirementIdsRequired from all prior checkpoints. Unexecuted IDs remain unexecuted until executed. Verdict phase may not drop IDs.

publishedSchemaRolesNamedGenerally.meaning: Closed admission order vocabulary on registered arrays. Stock JSON Schema does not enforce it. Independently implementing the published keyword is part of validating every record against its owning schema.
Published digest/retention annotations. Closure must retain and rejoin what the annotation requires.

The registered relation document owns ladder, rungs, subjectKind, anchorLaw, snapshotJoins, coverage totality/partition where present. Independently execute those laws at retained closure. They are not optional comments.
Native context/universe and nested records name source correspondence and retained preimages. Independently execute those joins. A schema-valid fragment that never joins is not admission.

original.quote: then independently implement and execute the retained closure and cross-record joins. Merely minting identifiers, validating a subset of fragments, or inserting true in a report is not admission

requirements.requirement: Independently implement and execute retained closure and cross-record joins named by the kit registries (relation laws, digest-domain snapshot/nested/blob joins, coverage totality/partition where present).
requirements.observable: closure result per claimed complete positive, distinct from schema-only validation
requirements.notSatisfiedBy: minted ids; subset fragments; inserted true; reminted self-equality

original.quote: Retain a machine-readable object table (typed identity, domain and descriptor), ALL exact blob/frame bytes keyed by digest (a base64 JSON export is sufficient)

requirements.requirement: For every claimed complete positive: object table plus all exact blob/frame bytes keyed by digest.
requirements.observable: runs/<id>.store.json (or equivalent) containing objectTable and blobs

original.quote: and an executable from-scratch command that recomputes identities and validates those complete graphs

requirements.requirement: An executable from-scratch command recomputes identities and validates those complete graphs from the export.
requirements.observable: documented command under {{OUTPUT_PATH}} using {{PYTHON}}

original.quote: Schema documents, capability manifests and other referenced artifacts are part of closure wherever the normative retention law requires them

requirements.requirement: Required referenced artifacts are in the export and rehashed.
requirements.observable: export contains those artifacts' digests/bytes

original.quote: Use each language/grammar's actual selected provider and capability context

requirements.requirement: Each language/grammar Run uses its actual selected provider and capability context.
requirements.observable: provider/context fields on each complete Run

original.quote: Keep valid controls distinct from invalid mutations and from explanatory calculations

requirements.requirement: Valid controls, invalid mutations, and explanatory calculations are labeled distinct.
requirements.observable: vector classification field valid|invalid|explanatory

original.quote: report measured results, not a count of labels. PASS line counts and schema observations are not assertions of full conformance

requirements.requirement: Measured results. PASS line counts are not conformance.
requirements.observable: assertions or failing process status on required controls

original.quote: For every negative state the first observed refusal boundary and whether it masks a later hypothesized check

requirements.requirement: Every negative records first refusal and masking.
requirements.observable: firstRefusal and masksLater on each negative

original.quote: Distinguish schema validation, helper predicates, full retained closure, and future host enforcement

requirements.requirement: Those four boundaries stay distinct. Helper predicates are not closure. Closure is not host enforcement.
requirements.observable: per claimed positive: schema vs helper vs closure vs (not claimed) host

original.quote: If your independent code has a bug, correct it using only the normative kit and preserve the original failure and correction. A helper bug with a precise existing normative answer is not a new design gap; an absent or contradictory required normative recipe is.

requirements.requirement: Helper bugs: correct from kit only; preserve original failure and correction. Helper bug ≠ design gap. Missing/contradictory required recipe = design gap. Open helper failure on a claimed positive forbids ACCEPT.
requirements.observable: helperCorrections[] with original failure, kit selector, correction

original.quote: Semantic proof replay is a separate REQUIRED step after identity/schema/closure admission

requirements.requirement: Replay after admission, not instead of it. A linkage-valid graph that has not passed this replay is not a complete positive.
requirements.observable: replay export per claimed complete positive, gated on closure

original.quote: Derive the complete subject enumeration; exact matchingFactIds and coverageIds

requirements.requirement: Independently derive complete subject enumeration and exact matchingFactIds and coverageIds.
requirements.observable: replay record containing those derived ids

original.quote: predicate addresses and child values; witnesses, all finding emissions and the final verdict from those inputs

requirements.requirement: Predicate addresses, child values, witnesses, all finding emissions, final verdict from those inputs.
requirements.observable: replay proof fields

original.quote: Do not supply caller-authored truth, empty-match flags or literal pass/fail as a substitute for this computation

requirements.requirement: No caller-authored truth / empty-match flags / literal pass-fail substitutes.
requirements.observable: evaluator reads retained program/views/facts/Coverage/scopes/imports only

original.quote: Compare the independently recomputed complete proof bundle to the retained claim and refuse any mismatch

requirements.requirement: Compare the independently recomputed complete proof bundle to the retained claim; refuse mismatch.
requirements.observable: byte/identity comparison result per positive; mismatch ⇒ that positive fails

original.quote: Export the replayed inputs, computed proof and exact comparison result for EVERY positive Run

requirements.requirement: Export replayed inputs, computed proof, and comparison for every positive Run.
requirements.observable: runs/<id>.replay.json (or equivalent) for each claimed positive

original.quote: Missing relation Coverage with no match must follow the published three-valued law

requirements.requirement: Missing relation Coverage with no match follows the published three-valued law.
requirements.observable: vector showing indeterminate, not vacuous true/false

original.quote: Include a discriminating tampered-result control that preserves valid record identities and citation membership while changing the claimed logical result, and demonstrate that replay refuses it

requirements.requirement: Tamper control: preserve valid record identities and citation membership, change claimed logical result, replay refuses. Keep this separate from future authentication/host qualification.
requirements.observable: tamper vector with refused=true and identities/citations described

original.quote: Retain a machine-readable object table ... ALL exact blob/frame bytes. independently implement and execute the retained closure

requirements.requirement: Export is sufficient for independent root admission of the exact bytes afterward. The consumer must not ACCEPT on helper self-consistency. The consumer must not import author models to obtain that admission.
requirements.observable: every claimed complete positive has a complete export path listed in blind-review.json

original.quote: Independently identify any missing recipe, conflicting type/field vocabulary, circular authority ordering, ambiguous default or required implementation choice that would force you to INVENT design

requirements.requirement: Identify missing recipe / conflicting vocabulary / circular authority / ambiguous default / forced invention. Exact selectors.
requirements.observable: newMustIssues/newShouldIssues or an explicit empty-with-justification after all acceptBlocking items executed

original.quote: Distinguish algorithm freedom explicitly left to implementation from a missing public/semantic contract

requirements.requirement: Algorithm freedom ≠ missing contract.
requirements.observable: gap write-up uses that distinction

original.quote: If you cannot build a promised vector from these normative inputs, report exact blocker rather than adjusting expected meaning or importing author code

requirements.requirement: Exact blocker, not adjusted meaning, not imported author code.
requirements.observable: BLOCKED or CHANGES_REQUIRED with selector, or all promised vectors built

original.quote: Deliver blind-review.md AND blind-review.json

requirements.requirement: Deliver both review files plus retained source and machine-readable vector outputs.
requirements.observable: {{OUTPUT_PATH}}/blind-review.md and blind-review.json

original.quote: ACCEPT-RECONSTRUCTABLE or CHANGES_REQUIRED (or actual BLOCKED)

requirements.requirement: Verdict is one of ACCEPT-RECONSTRUCTABLE, CHANGES_REQUIRED, BLOCKED. Substantive, not a checklist count. Any remaining MUST/SHOULD design gap requires CHANGES_REQUIRED.
requirements.observable: blind-review.json verdict field

original.quote: Include top-level newMustIssues and newShouldIssues arrays, both empty only when no unresolved required finding remains; report nonblocking advisories separately

requirements.requirement: newMustIssues and newShouldIssues empty only when no unresolved required finding remains. Advisories separate. Exact selectors.
requirements.observable: those arrays plus advisories[]

original.quote: Do not return an accepting verdict while required reconstruction remains unexecuted or its complete positive controls fail. report unexecuted reconstruction as incomplete

requirements.requirement: ACCEPT is forbidden while any acceptBlocking requirement is unexecuted or any claimed complete positive fails schema/closure/replay/export. Incomplete or helper failure cannot ACCEPT.
requirements.observable: verdict plus unexecuted list; if unexecuted nonempty then verdict ≠ ACCEPT-RECONSTRUCTABLE

original.quote: No claim of full product qualification or implementation authorization

requirements.requirement: No product qualification or implementation authorization claim.
requirements.observable: standing text in both review files

original.quote: Real OS/compiler/crypto/SQLite measurements are future qualification; do not demand product already exists

futureQualification.requirement: Do not demand real OS/compiler/crypto/SQLite measurements. Do not treat their absence as a design gap.

original.quote: Synthetic TCB observations are assumptions, never native enforcement proof

futureQualification.requirement: Synthetic TCB observations are assumptions, never native enforcement proof.

original.quote: Keep this separate from future authentication/host qualification

futureQualification.requirement: Replay tamper control is not authentication/host qualification.
futureQualification.observable: tamper vector classified as evaluator replay, not host auth

pendingSuccessorOwner.requirement: Bounded graph-query operation, disclosure, and cursor reconstruction is pending the exact successor owner after W handoff. Do not invent fields, envelopes, or cursor identity from historical graph-query schema filenames in the kit. Historical graph-query schema files remain kit custody inputs; they are not a licence to guess the successor recipe. After owner selectors are filled, this slot becomes an ordinary acceptBlocking requirement of the kind the owner names (complete Run vs vector vs envelope). Until then it must not be treated as executed, unexecuted-required, or a current design gap.
pendingSuccessorOwner.observable: charter/review records status PENDING_EXACT_SUCCESSOR_OWNER with empty ownerSelectors until handoff

counts.note: Exact array lengths are authoritative; this object is a convenience and must match.
